title: Al-Ikhlas: Working for Allah, Not for People
summary: In an age of display and appearances, teach your teenager to act for Allah’s sake, not to seek the admiration of people. Al-Ikhlas liberates him from the bondage of others’ opinions and gives his deeds a meaning and steadiness that comparisons cannot shake.
try_this: This week: Talk about the difference between working for Allah and working to show off, using an example from his own life.
reflection_prompts: Does your teenager become captive to people’s admiration?
How have you introduced him to Al-Ikhlas?

review_defects.why: Arabic uses dual imperative 'تحدّثا' (you two talk), implying a mutual conversation between parent and teenager. English 'Talk about' is ambiguous and could be interpreted as a command to the parent alone, losing the dual nuance.
